lines.zh: 我小小的身体一跳一跳地走。
lines.en: My little body hops along.

lines.zh: 我走在草丛里，草都比我高。
lines.en: I walk in the grass and it's taller than me.
I wobble forward.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边发出小声音。
lines.en: I make little sounds as I go.

lines.zh: 我从一片叶子底下钻过去。
lines.en: I slip under a leaf.

lines.zh: 我绕着一块石头走了两圈。
lines.en: I go twice around a stone.
I'm slow, but I'm trying.
My feet are small and my steps are light.
I go past a tree root.
I push the grass aside and squeeze in.
I sit with my feet off the ground.
My body puffs in and out.
My eyes blink, once and shut.
I wiggle my short legs.
The sun warms me up.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己的短腿发呆。
lines.en: I stare at my own stubby legs.
I blow a little bubble.
I don't feel scared at all.
I'm counting the pebbles on the ground.
My belly is round.
My head tips slowly round.
A bug crawls past.
I blow another bubble.
Your knee comes up to my eyes.
I look up at you — very high.

lines.zh: 你蹲下之后，我才把头探出来。
lines.en: Only after you crouch do I poke my head out.
I come a little closer.

lines.zh: 我绕到你身后，又跑回来。
lines.en: I circle behind you and run back.

lines.zh: 你影子把我整个盖住了。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me whole.
Will you step on me?
I peek out at you again.
I tilt my head at your hands.
I tilt my head further.
I look up wide-eyed.
I stop still by your foot.
I cry out and curl up.
It stings a bit.
I stay silent under a blade of grass.
My bubbles popped.
Done shaking, I flop back down.
I am not crying at all.
It stings, so I roll onto my belly.
Whimper... you popped all my bubbles.
I shuffle toward that smell.
This is better than my usual food.
Swallowed in one gulp, a little hot.
That will last me a while.
Can I have a little more?
I got it all over my face.
I sit right where I am.
I am full now.
This little blob rolls along the ground.
I get up and wobble.
My bubbles all popped.
I roll away and pick up dust.
I'm far smaller than you.
I wobble twice and steady.
I call out, a bit put out.
You bumped me. Watch your feet.
I'm the only one around.
I haven't been out of the egg long.
I'm not big enough for much yet.
My days are eating and sleeping.
I sleep under a leaf.

lines.zh: 我把脸埋进自己的肚子。
lines.en: I bury my face in my own belly.
Tomorrow I'll be a little bigger.

lines.zh: 我们凑一对，孵颗新蛋吧。
lines.en: Let's pair up and hatch a new egg.
I open up and bite it.
I can't drag it, so I sit on it.
I nudge it along with my head.
It rolled off to one side.
I roll after it.
I sniff and leave it be.
I set it on top of my head.
It fell off and hit me.
Something's shuffling ahead.
I look up at it.

lines.zh: 我对着它的影子鼓起腮。
lines.en: I puff my cheeks at its shadow.
I hatched in a dripstone cave.
I shuffle toward it.
I've got my eye on it.
At this range I'm close.
It hasn't looked my way.

lines.zh: 这么小的我，又凑近一点。
lines.en: Small as I am, I edge a little closer.
So small, like a little sun.
I follow with little shuffles.

lines.zh: 我这点光，刚够照亮自己。
lines.en: My little glow only lights myself.
It halted, and I did too.

lines.zh: 我又吐了一个泡泡出来。
lines.en: I blow another bubble out.
I'm closer now.
It's turned the other way.
My mouth is ready.
This is my chance.
I don't want to miss it.
I hold perfectly still and watch it.
The bubble floats over and sticks to it.
The bubble hits it.
I lunge and bite.
It shoved me.
It knocked me into two rolls.
It has backed off.
I stand there and watch it.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在它的后腿上。
lines.en: I bite into its hind leg.
Everything looks very tall.
My feet aren't steady yet.
I wobbled twice and sat down.

lines.zh: 黏液顺着我的背往下流。
lines.en: Slime runs down my back.

lines.zh: 我从壳里挤出半截身子。
lines.en: I squeeze half my body out of the shell.
Grass and light all around.
I crawl two steps.
I blew a little bubble again.
I sit and look around.
I don't know where this is.
Fire burns me and I roll away fast.

lines.zh: 我从上面掉下来，摔得扁扁的。
lines.en: I fall from a height and land flat.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我吐着泡泡挣。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth and I thrash, blowing bubbles.
The blast bounces me far away.
An arrow skims past me.
Something feels strange inside me.
A Baby I wobbles when hungry.

lines.zh: 雷响了一下，我整个人都僵了。
lines.en: A crack of thunder and I go stiff.
The floor's gone and I keep dropping.
